settings.yield_wallpaper.label: Hide Noctalia's wallpaper while waywallen runs
settings.yield_wallpaper.description: Asks Noctalia to stop drawing its own wallpaper surface on every output, so the wallpaper switch cannot cover waywallen's live wallpaper. The bar widget can suspend this temporarily.
settings.require_running.label: Only while waywallen is running
settings.require_running.description: Yield only when a waywallen process is detected, restoring Noctalia's wallpaper when it is not. Turn off to yield unconditionally (a black background shows if waywallen is not running).
settings.manage_daemon.label: Manage the waywallen service
settings.manage_daemon.description: Start the systemd user unit when the plugin is enabled and stop it when the plugin is disabled or removed. Leave off when waywallen is started by your NixOS / home-manager configuration.
settings.unit.label: Service unit
settings.unit.description: systemd user unit that runs waywallen. Used only when 'Manage the waywallen service' is on.
settings.poll_seconds.label: Poll interval (seconds)
settings.poll_seconds.description: How often to re-check whether waywallen is running and re-assert the yield.
settings.glyph.label: Icon
